candidates.description: Patch production Next/Nest runtime packages and Nest testing peer compatibility while deliberately keeping Nest CLI/schematics on v11 so TypeScript 6 is not introduced merely to create an audit proposal. Prisma remains committed 6.19.3.

Exploratory audit-only candidate: patched Next/Nest runtime packages plus npm-audit suggested Prisma 6.12.0 pair. Never auto-adopt; must pass deterministic install, schema generation, regression, six-app build, PostgreSQL integration and browser UAT before commit.

notes: Proposal generation is isolated from the checked-out source tree.
The committed npm audit gate remains authoritative and is never bypassed.

Nest CLI/schematics stay on the committed v11 toolchain in these candidates because Nest 12 schematics requires TypeScript >=6.0; tooling migration must be evaluated separately from production vulnerability remediation.

Candidates are diagnostics only. A PASS candidate must still be manually adopted into source and pass deterministic npm ci, Prisma validation/generation, all regression, six-app build, PostgreSQL integration and browser UAT.

Prisma 6.12.0 appears only in the second exploratory candidate because npm audit currently recommends that downgrade for the @prisma/config/deepmerge-ts advisory; it must not be committed without compatibility proof.
